question: Why do hosted ios-foundation runs fail the original native image comparisons while local runs pass?
rootCause: Hosted macOS runners attach a 1x virtual display. The capture helper read window.backingScaleFactor (1.0), so AppKit/SwiftUI rasterized text at 1x; the 2x scaleEffect canvas then magnified blurred 1x glyphs. Layout, positions and dimensions were already identical.

reproduction.method: Temporary uncommitted NSWindow subclass forcing backingScaleFactor=1 with the unchanged helper

fix.source: Adopted W4 PR #53 helper verbatim (ReferenceScaleWindow reports 2x; bitmap maps two pixels per point)
fix.localResult: 18 checks, 0 failures; all 110 original comparisons within the unchanged exact-dimension 99.85%-within-8 contract

variantWithoutPrepareLayer.note: The retained prepareLayer redraw is redundant once the window reports 2x; left in place to match PR #53 exactly.

fix.workflow: ios-foundation restored to main's xcode-27 runner; the macos-26-intel/Xcode 26.5 switch rested on a misdiagnosis
